text:
[RFCS.4.8] `wall_start_iso8601` is the host wall-clock time at which
the stream opened, in UTC, ISO 8601 (for example
`2026-06-18T14:30:00.123456Z`). It is **provenance metadata, not a
replay input**: a reader must drive replay from the engine monotonic
clock ([RFCS.6.6]), never from this field, so an incorrect or
unsynchronised host clock cannot perturb a replay. It anchors the
monotonic timeline to calendar time — `wall_start_iso8601` plus the
engine-clock span ([RFCS.6.6]) gives both when the stream ran and how
long it took. The ISO-8601 string carries the offset inline. The field is optional
(`""` when unanchored); its absence is never fatal ([RFCS.4.7] does not
gate on it) because it is provenance, not a binding or replay input.
